facts.note: The reCAPTCHA program originated with Guatemalan computer scientist Luis von Ahn ... developed at Carnegie Mellon University
The system helped to digitize the archives of The New York Times ... the digitization of books
It was acquired by Google in September 2009.
CAPTCHA(Completely Automated Public Turing test to tell Computers and Humans Apart, 완전 자동화된 사람과 컴퓨터 판별, 캡차)
CAPTCHAs are sometimes described as reverse Turing tests.
The term was coined in 2003 by Luis von Ahn, Manuel Blum, Nicholas J. Hopper, and John Langford.
